name: GET Wasos messages
info:
Fetches recent chat messages from a WaSOS chatroom via the REST API.

### Input
`msg.metadata.source` = WaSOS Client

### Logic
Builds `GET /api/chat/messages/{chatroom_name}?limit=50` with `x-api-key` from `source.client_specific`. Unwraps `msg.payload.messages`.

### Output
`msg.payload` = array of raw WaSOS message objects

name: Build Wasos /chat/messages/ request
info: Builds HTTP request to fetch chat messages from WaSOS. Sets x-api-key header and constructs URL from wasosChatroomUrl with ?limit=50 parameter to fetch the last 50 messages.
